rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS / SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS / FISCAL YEAR 2011`, PDF page 62 of the FY2011 annual town report. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, VERBATIM AND IN ORDER, READ OFF THIS PAGE (rule 13b.4): `PROGRAM NAME` | `APPROPRIATED FORWARD` | `TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE` | `TOTAL EXPENDED` | `TOTAL ENCUMBERED` | `BALANCE TO REVENUE`. WHY THAT HEADER MATTERS HERE. CLAUDE.md rule 13 names FY2011 as this archive's worked example of a check with no power to fail: `v1` in the generic annual-report extracts means THE FIRST COLUMN OF THIS PAGE THAT HELD FIGURES, the ruler is built per page, and summing v1 across a run adds one page's APPROPRIATED to another's TOTAL EXPENDED -- FY2011 came out within 1% of its own printed total that way. On every appropriations page of this report the first money column is `APPROPRIATED FORWARD`: an appropriation, or a prior-year carry-forward where the cell is followed by the word `fwd`, or a short-term borrowing where it is followed by `srt`. It is NOT total funds available and it is NOT total expended. The names used in this file are the printed names. HOW THE TABLE IS SHAPED. Each department prints its line items (Payroll, Other Expenses, and where it applies a bare carry-forward on the heading row) and then an UNLABELLED rule-and-total row carrying up to all five columns. The line items are recorded here as `line` rows, so they are published and not summed; the department total rows are the `fund` rows and carry the check. WHAT PROVES IT. The page prints no grand total, so the proof is the identity the table states about itself on every department row -- total funds available less total expended less total encumbered is the balance returned to revenue -- which is DECLARED here and re-asserted by `verify_page_reads.py` on every run. Beyond that, and recomputed at the time of transcription, EVERY department's line items foot to its own total row in all four money columns: thirteen departments, recomputed and all closing to the cent -- Fire Department 113,594.16+337,349.13+96,257.33+3,300.00+38,469.93 = 588,970.55 expended against a printed 588,970.55, its available column 115,085.05+325,130.12+101,366.00+3,300.00+45,735.40 = 590,616.57, and its appropriated column 2,241.00 srt +112,844.05+325,130.12+101,366.00+3,300.00+45,735.40 = 590,616.57; Building Inspector 69,712.69+2,500.00+43,979.54+1,113.40 = 117,305.63; Animal Control Officer 11,580.00+7,920.00+4,953.11 = 24,453.11. No department failed any column. TWO DEPARTMENTS PRINT ONE ROW THAT IS ALSO THEIR TOTAL ROW -- Mtc of Town Radios and Municipal Hearings Officer -- and carry no line items beneath them. A department whose total row prints no `BALANCE TO REVENUE` cell is left with no value in that column rather than a zero, so nothing asserts an identity the page does not state (the FY2014 case where absent was scored as zero and read as the town's arithmetic failing). ROWS ARE KEYED BY PRINTED POSITION. `Payroll` and `Other Expenses` are printed under almost every department, so `fund_number` is the department's ordinal down the page (p62-01 upward) and, for a line item, that ordinal plus the item's ordinal within the department. Nothing on this page is keyed on a printed name.
